description: 鉄道輸送実績・財務関連データ(2025年度) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 総合政策局情報政策課. 本データセットは2025年度のProject LINKSにおいて作成されました。 Project LINKS： mlit. go. jp/links/ 「鉄道輸送実績・財務関連データ」とは、鉄道統計年報の輸送実績情報および財務関連情報を機械判読できるよう整形したデータです。 鉄道統計年報は、全国の鉄道、軌道、索道事... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 総合政策局情報政策課. Its tags are 営業キロ及び走行キロ, 延日キロ, 損益計算書, 財務, 輸送実績. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 公共データ利用規約（第1.0版). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
